dependencyDecision.compilerOnly: Original gosu 1.19 Go source, go.mod and go.sum unchanged; original dependency suite passed. Keeps the two dependency advisories as a conservative tested fallback.
dependencyDecision.p2: Same gosu 1.19 production Go source; moby/sys/user 0.4.1 and x/sys 0.44.0 with pinned Go module checksums. All five native candidate gates passed.
dependencyDecision.upstreamTestException: moby/sys/user 0.4.1 TestParseGroupFileCapsReads uses NUL padding. Its below-cap fixture expects NULs to be ignored, but bytes.TrimSpace does not remove NULs; its near-cap fixtures create a single almost-10-MiB token, exceeding the existing 1-MiB line bound before the independent file cap. This single named test is excluded, not represented as passed. No production parser is patched.
dependencyDecision.replacementProof: dependency-review/security_test.go checks the 10-MiB read limit with valid blank lines: below and exactly at the cap succeed, one byte beyond fails. It also checks device/directory rejection, oversized single-line rejection, valid named UID/GID/supplementary groups, and failure instead of partial identity when passwd/group reads overflow. The rest of the upstream dependency suite passed, followed by native identity parity and all database gates.
dependencyDecision.notAClaim: Malformed local passwd/group data is not proven universally safe by these tests; the helper remains a root-startup privilege dropper, not a setuid/sudo replacement. No advisory suppression was added.
